summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed the scope of anomaly detection within the analytics system. It was confirmed that when analyzing anomalies, the data is treated per sensor/location (facility), meaning multiple boxes in one location are not combined into a single facility unit.

A potential improvement to the algorithm was discussed: comparing peaks across different vendors for a single sensor. Currently, if a peak occurs across all vendors, it is excluded; however, suggesting that implementing cross-vendor comparison could be beneficial, as a simultaneous jump across all vendors might indicate normal activity.
decisions: The current anomaly detection algorithm operates on a per-sensor basis (facility).
action_items: Create a ticket to evaluate implementing cross-vendor peak comparison in the analytics algorithm.
